en.title: ZEY' BREAK
en.summary: This article introduces "ZEY' BREAK," a performance featuring choreography by Kadir Memis alias "Amigo." It includes contributions from Zula Lemes for consultation and Nevzat Akpinar for composition. The performance stars Kadir Memis and Yavuz Topuz alias "Risk One" and was presented at Ballhaus Naunynstrasse.
en.excerpt: This article presents "ZEY' BREAK," a performance choreographed by Kadir Memis alias "Amigo." It features consultation by Zula Lemes and composition by Nevzat Akpinar, starring Kadir Memis and Yavuz Topuz alias "Risk One." The event took place at Ballhaus Naunynstrasse.
